label: Ernst Salomon Cyprian as Gotha library and coin-cabinet hub
date_note: 1673–1745; institutional roles relevant here from 1713 onward.

features.value: director of the Herzogliche Bibliothek Gotha; substantially expanded and scholarly organised the collections
director of the Gotha Münzkabinett from 1723
correspondence archive preserves incoming scholarly letters, manuscripts and collection-related enclosures; personal manuscripts and prints entered the Herzogliche Bibliothek after his death

sources.citation: Franckesche Stiftungen digital person index, Ernst Salomon Cyprian
DFG project on Ernst Salomon Cyprian's historiographical sources at Schloss Friedenstein Gotha

notes: Major newly identified institutional node. Cyprian is not merely a correspondent: he controlled a research library and, from the exact launch year of the Weigel/Köhler calendar (1723), the Gotha coin cabinet. This establishes infrastructure for possible transmission without proving what specific ideas or objects moved through him.

label: Christian Schlegel → Ernst Salomon Cyprian correspondence

relations.note: Two surviving autograph letters from Christian Schlegel to Cyprian.

sources.citation: Kalliope / Forschungsbibliothek Gotha, Nachlass Ernst Salomon Cyprian, Chart. A 423

notes: The correspondence edge is certain; contents have not yet been read in this sweep. Do not claim that Schlegel's numismatic manuscript or method was discussed until the letters are inspected.

label: Wilhelm Ernst Tentzel → Cyprian correspondence and posthumous editorial custody

relations.note: Surviving Tentzel letters to Cyprian in 1700 and 1705.
Cyprian edited/published Tentzel's historical report with a preface, documents and registers in 1717–18.

features.value: Tentzel to Cyprian, 22 June 1700, Chart. A 422, S.341-344
Tentzel to Cyprian, 24 July 1705, Chart. A 422, S.345-348
Cyprian publishes Tentzel's posthumous Reformation history and useful previously unpublished documents

sources.citation: Kalliope / Forschungsbibliothek Gotha, Nachlass Ernst Salomon Cyprian, Chart. A 422
DDB/ULB Halle, Wilhelm Ernst Tentzels Historischer Bericht..., edited by Ernst Salomon Cyprian, Leipzig 1717

notes: This is stronger than a later citation: Cyprian was a direct Tentzel correspondent and a posthumous editor/custodian of Tentzel historical materials. It does not by itself show custody of Tentzel's numismatic papers.

label: Johann Georg von Eccard → Cyprian correspondence, including 1724–25

relations.note: Multiple surviving autograph letters across more than two decades.

features.value: multiple letters 1699–1701, Chart. A 423
letters 20 Mar., 3 Apr., 30 June 1718, Chart. A 425
5 Dec. 1721, Chart. A 426
1 July 1725, Würzburg→Gotha, Chart. A 429, Bl.201r-203v
9 Sep. 1725, Würzburg, Chart. A 429, Bl.200r/v

sources.citation: Kalliope / Forschungsbibliothek Gotha, Nachlass Ernst Salomon Cyprian, Chart. A 423, 425, 426, 429

notes: Extremely important chronology: Eccard remains in direct correspondence with Cyprian during the exact 1724–25 Clio-transition window, while Cyprian directs the Gotha library and coin cabinet. The content of the 1724/1725 letters is not yet known; no claim about coins, genealogy or the Nürnberg publication should be made until inspection.

label: Antique and early-modern medal collection lists in Cyprian correspondence, 1725

features.value: Johann Gotthilf Vockerodt to Cyprian, 1 Dec. 1725
catalogue/list of a collection of ancient medals, c.1725, three leaves
catalogue/list of a collection of sixteenth- and seventeenth-century medals

sources.citation: Kalliope / Forschungsbibliothek Gotha, Nachlass Ernst Salomon Cyprian, Chart. A 429, Bl.265r-269v

notes: Direct evidence that Cyprian's 1725 correspondence network was feeding numismatic collection information into Gotha. The lists should be inspected for provenance, owners, objects and whether drawings/impressions accompanied them.

label: Johann David Köhler → Ernst Salomon Cyprian correspondence

relations.note: Multiple surviving autograph letters in Cyprian's Nachlass.

features.value: 10 June 1741, Göttingen, Chart. A 443, Bl.63r/v,66r/v
29 Sep. 1742, Göttingen, Chart. A 444, Bl.207r/v,211br/v
17 July 1743, Göttingen, Chart. A 444, Bl.208r/v,211ar/v

sources.citation: Kalliope / Forschungsbibliothek Gotha, Nachlass Ernst Salomon Cyprian, Chart. A 443–444

notes: This provides a direct social-documentary route from Köhler into the same Gotha hub that had corresponded with Schlegel, Tentzel and Eccard. The letter contents remain uninspected. 1743 is also the year Köhler's Münz-Belustigung treats a Tentzel commemorative medal, making content inspection especially high priority.

label: Cyprian as bounded transmission hub linking Schlegel, Tentzel, Eccard and Köhler
notes: The network route is real; the transmitted content is not yet established. Do NOT say Cyprian transmitted Schlegel's numismatic manuscript, the Clio motto, or a specific evidentiary method to Köhler without letter/manuscript evidence. The next research step is content-level inspection of the correspondence and Gotha collection records.
